contract: Replay-first experiment viewer, genuine pixel world, readable proportional UI, one selected-agent panel above the village, observed prefix only, recorded model metadata and verified coins separate from score. No engine/rule/model-call changes.

accessibility.evidence: Scoped manual review: labeled buttons/tabs, arrow-key tab navigation, visible focus and Escape deselection passed. Text palette inspected from production build. This is not a full WCAG certification; axe/native screen reader and OS reduced-motion emulation were not run.

responsive.evidence: Independent rendered desktop/tablet/mobile review plus production screenshots. No horizontal page overflow at390/768; narrow inspector uses accessible tabs. Preview screenshot service sometimes clips the desktop artifact; browser viewport was1440x900.

loading.evidence: Existing source loading/connection labels retained; recorded JSON and Neon pages loaded into actual village after initial fetch. No fake live fallback.

empty.evidence: Selected replay agent before first offer shows No claims yet and Not final, not a meaningful zero rate.

error.evidence: Reviewer observed unavailable API503 with explicit error; public actor socket503 reported without substitution. No new paid request.

partial.evidence: Selected replay at event13 shows only prefix, nonfinal score and partial-round coin chart. Missing/tampered event helper returns unavailable in regression.

success.evidence: Recorded replay selects/deselects, seeksR1-R6-R1, preserves metadata and opens persisted run-specific report.

permission.evidence: Production build served locally with VERCEL=1: missing operator token disables both start buttons; all five mutation routes returned403 before work.

renderedEvidence.observation: Independent desktop inspector review; actual recorded metadata, observer labels, chart and bounded activity.
Tablet coin tab shows prefix balance and separate score; village remains below panel.
Narrow operator-restricted launch with readable condition controls and replay recovery.

limitations: New UI is local, not yet verified on public Vercel.
Native reduced-motion emulation, automated axe, Core Web Vitals, and screen-reader audit remain unverified.
Historical exact model metadata absent in other recordings is explicitly unavailable, not inferred.
